environment.description: ECS Fargate service deployed in an isolated private subnet with task networking configured through a PrivateLink-only VPC. The security group attached to the ENI has egress rules limited to port 443 towards the VPC endpoint prefix list (pl-63a5400a for S3, pl-02cd2c6b for DynamoDB) and a self-referencing rule for internal ALB health checks on port 8080. No NAT gateway or internet gateway is attached to the route table associated with the task subnet. DNS resolution within the VPC is handled by Route 53 Resolver inbound endpoints that only resolve internal hosted zones (*.internal.corp) and AWS service endpoints. The task execution role has a permissions boundary (arn:aws:iam::123456789012:policy/FargateNetworkRestriction) that denies ec2:CreateNetworkInterface outside the designated subnet. Additionally, the container image is built with a distroless base that excludes curl, wget, and nslookup binaries. SRI validation is enabled for the /api/fetch-config endpoint.

config.security_group_egress: port 443 to pl-63a5400a, pl-02cd2c6b only; port 8080 self-referencing
config.route_table: local VPC CIDR only + VPC endpoints
config.dns_resolver: Route 53 Resolver inbound, internal zones only
